name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russian strikes cut power to more than 850,000 on 8 Nov; US-brokered Abu Dhabi talks are set for 10–11 Nov
state: Russian strikes on 8 Nov left more than 850,000 customers without power, including over 600,000 in Dnipropetrovsk region, DTEK said, with supply being restored (Euronews). President Zelenskyy said drones hit rescuers at Komyshuvakha, site of the 2 Nov bombing, and reported 115 missiles and over 3,000 attack drones in the past week. Russia's defence ministry says it will keep striking energy sites (Al Jazeera). US-brokered talks are set for Abu Dhabi on 10–11 Nov.
for_you: FCDO travel advice is the official guide for anyone with links to Ukraine. Attacks on energy sites affect heating and water supply as winter begins.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on energy infrastructure, escalating before talks = Alert
